stories.title: Sweden's left-wing opposition leads incumbent government in exit polls as far-right slips to third
stories.reason: SVT's exit poll puts Magdalena Andersson's four-party bloc at 51.3% against PM Kristersson's 46.8%, with the Sweden Democrats dropping out of second place -- though Swedish exit polls wrongly called the 2022 result, so official counting still matters.

stories.title: Kushner says US used Israel's 'global isolation' after botched Doha strike to force through the Gaza deal
stories.reason: The unusually candid admission that Washington leveraged the diplomatic fallout from Israel's failed strike on Hamas leaders in Qatar reveals how the October ceasefire and hostage release were actually brokered.

stories.title: US import ban on Canadian dairy, alcohol and motorcycles set to take effect this week as trade war escalates
stories.reason: Washington's proclamations banning Canadian whey, molasses, spirits and larger motorcycles take hold September 15 and 29, a sharp escalation beyond tariffs that follows Canada's own retaliatory measures against US goods.

stories.title: Trump's phased 200% tariff on generic drugs sends Indian pharma stocks tumbling
stories.reason: Shares in Dr Reddy's, Cipla, Sun Pharma and other major exporters fell as the plan to ramp tariffs to 200% by 2029 threatens the roughly 40% of US generic-drug volume that India supplies.

stories.title: Salesforce launches seven named Agentforce AI agents ahead of Dreamforce
stories.reason: Casey, Paige, Carter, Hunter, Marshall, Piper and Fin each target a specific business function and plug into Customer 360 data, with Hunter piloting a long-horizon runtime that pursues sales goals over weeks rather than single chat sessions.

stories.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi military base as Yemen's civil war intensifies
stories.reason: Renewed fighting since Yemen's civil war reignited in July has killed hundreds and displaced tens of thousands, with Saudi Arabia striking the Houthi stronghold of Saada in response to cross-border attacks.

stories.title: Senate Republicans unveil revised 630-page CLARITY Act as Trump huddles with advisers on crypto ethics language before Monday's vote
stories.reason: The cloture vote needs seven Democratic votes Republicans don't yet have, with ethics provisions restricting officials including Trump from profiting off crypto ventures still a sticking point despite over 100 revisions.

stories.title: OpenAI opens its low-latency GPT-Live voice model to developers via API
stories.reason: The stateful architecture cut response latency from 1.63 to 0.798 seconds at $0.05 a minute, intensifying competition for real-time voice AI as OpenAI, Google and others race to make agents feel conversational rather than turn-based.
